Interestingly, a cousin of the deceased victim met with Daoud after the crash, hugged him, and said he forgave him but urged him to take responsibility. Daoud allegedly sobbed and apologized without admitting or denying fault. The footage showed Daoud entering the driver's seat, wearing the sweater he later ditched, along with his black crocks found in the driver's area.
